laws.rule: Diamond Head State Monument: non-residents need entry and parking reservations; entry US$5 (about A$7.10 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) per person (3 and under free), parking US$10 per vehicle, card only. Open 6am to 6pm, last entry 4:30pm for the 4pm slot; closed Christmas and New Year's Day. No pets except service animals.
